notes: Page 2 only shows minifigure assembly (Squidman: head, cape, torso, legs; and the pilot minifigure). Minifigure pieces are not in the parts list or catalogue, so no parts or edges were added.
Step 2: white 2-finger hinge plate attached at one end of the black 2x4 plate, fingers pointing outward; assumed to overlap one stud column (2 studs) of the plate.
Step 3: white 1x4 side-stud brick sits on one row of the black plate, also covering the hinge plate stud at the end (assumed joined to both).
Step 4: Technic brick 1x2 placed on the remaining free studs of the black plate at the front end, holes facing outward; assumed joined to the plate only.

Step 5: gray 2x3 plate placed on top at the rear; assumed joined to the white 1x4 brick (b3) only. Image shows one blue pin inserted and another being inserted into the Technic brick; both pins recorded here.
Step 6: two trans-green cones fitted onto the outer ends of the two blue pins (engine nozzles). White side-handle plate placed on the gray plate.
Sub-assembly: white curved wedge brick with a dark grille tile at the rear and stickers (POLICE and a dark oval) applied; then attached in step 7 onto the side studs of the 1x4 side-stud brick (b3).
Left/right of the curved wedge is ambiguous; assumed lego-41747 (right), its mirror 41748 presumably used on the other side later.
Sticker sheet recorded as one node (b13) joined to the wedge.
Mirror sub-assembly: left curved wedge (41748) with grille tile and POLICE sticker (same sticker sheet b13), attached in step 8 to the opposite side of the model.
Exact attachment studs on the far side are unclear; assumed joined to the black base plate (b1) and gray plate (b5).

Step 9 pieces are small and not labelled: identified as trans-red and trans-dark-blue cheese slopes (cockpit), a white flag clipped onto the side-handle plate (b10), and a black clip tile; assignments are inferred from the parts list.
Step 10: red badge sticker applied to the flag (same sticker sheet b13) and black handlebars attached to the black clip tile (b19).
Slopes and clip tile assumed placed on the gray plate (b5); exact studs unclear.

New small sub-assembly (inset shows a small white/black/red craft). Piece identification is inferred: step 2 adds a white side-handle plate on top and a black 1-finger hinge plate underneath the black 2x2 plate; step 3 a red 2x2 plate; step 4 two black brackets on the sides.
The red stripe seen in step 4 is a sticker (sheet b13) but its target part is not certain, so no edge was added for it.
Exact stud overlaps between brackets and plates are assumed.
Step 5 appears to be the step 4 assembly turned over (white side-handle plate b22 visible); no new part identified.
Step 6: one white sloped 4x2 triple wedge added; left/right is ambiguous, assumed lego-43711 (the left one 43710 presumably follows later).
Step 11: the finished sub-assembly is attached to the rear of the main craft by interlocking the hinge fingers (b23 black 1-finger hinge with b2 white 2-finger hinge).
Step 12 only places the pilot minifigure (gripping the black handlebars) in the finished police craft. Minifigure pieces are not in the parts list, so nothing was added.
Page 12 is advertising (Space Police range and character line-up); no building step.
Page 13 is advertising (Space Police sets 5973/5974 and character line-up); no building step.
Page 14 is the parts inventory and customer service page; no building step.
Page 15 is LEGO Club advertising; no building step.
Page 16 is a survey and prize advertisement; no building step.

The inventory lists six pieces that I had not placed: 2540 x1, 3020 x1, 30414 x1, 3794b x1, 43710 x1 and 3069bpr0100 x1. The booklet's small isometric drawings make several pieces hard to tell apart, so I added them with best-guess positions. The exact placement and stud overlaps of these pieces are uncertain.
b29 (second black 2x4 plate) is assumed to be stacked under the base plate b1; step 3 shows a thick black base.
b28 (second 1x4 side-stud brick) is assumed to sit beside b3 on the base plate, under the gray plate b5.
b30 (third side-handle plate) and b31 (jumper plate) are assumed to sit on the gray plate b5.
b32 is the left sloped wedge, the mirror of b27, assumed to sit on the red plate b24 and the bracket b26 of the small rear craft.
b33 (green banknote tile) is held in the Squidman minifigure's hand on page 2. It has no joined edge because minifigures are not in the parts list or catalogue.
The checker's message was cut off after 'not in the list'. I found no piece of mine that is outside the parts list, so I changed nothing for that part of the complaint.
The two groups are the police craft and the green banknote tile b33. I checked that every craft piece is connected, including the small rear craft, which is hinged to the main craft by b23 and b2.

The banknote tile b33 is only held in the Squidman minifigure's hand on page 2. The booklet never attaches it to the craft, so it stays unconnected. Squidman and the pilot are minifigures that are not in the parts list or catalogue, so there is no node to attach it to.
